text_block_list.text:
Summer camp in our Senior Year has 
arrived. Arriving at the camp lodge under 
the hot summer sky—

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna do this~!! This 
summer will be Sol Lapis-chan's summer of 
great leaps!! First, dibs on the room~!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text: Ah, hey! ...Geez, Lapis is way too hyper.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“Still, though, you're looking more fired 
up than last year yourself, Cure.”

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
"...Thanks to a certain someone, my fire's 
been lit. I'm entering the Autumn Tenno 
Sho too. Let's have a showdown for old 
time's sake, Bubble."

Following Bubble Gum Fellow's Takarazuka 
Kinen, the Big Four regained their lively 
spirit once more.

And that is also having a tremendously 
positive impact on Bubble Gum Fellow—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—Alright. Let's blaze a new trail again 
this summer.
choice_data_list:
Yeah. Let's expand on those 
possibilities!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "Not yet...!! Not yet, I need more...!!"

A summer of breakthrough for each of them 
was about to begin—
